title: Overview should display BG data once it's configured
symptom: When the BG data source is set up, the BG data should appear on the Overview page--even if other aspects of the loop aren't configured. Otherwise, users are given the impression that there's a problem with the configuration/functionality of their BG source. It's a pretty minor issue since it resolves itself once the rest of the loop is configured, but it's nonetheless confusing.
cause: there must be an active profile. without profile it's not possible to calculate many things rendered on overview.
fix: There should be clear message "NO PROFILE" visible. As update to 3.0 changes DB there is no active profile migrated and must be done again.
evidence_quote: there must be an active profile. without profile it's not possible to calculate many things rendered on overview. There should be clear message "NO PROFILE" visible
